verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bento tracks events, ties revenue to campaigns/flows, and lets you filter subscribers by tags/segments/dates, implying some analytics capability, but there is no documentation of a dedicated per-campaign or per-automation-step dashboard showing opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions over time. missing for 10: explicit reporting/analytics documentation showing opens/clicks/unsubscribes/conversions broken out per campaign and per automation step over time, and any independent or hands-on confirmation of such reporting UI.
